factory.name: OrgChart.create
factory.signature: OrgChart.create(host: HTMLElement, options: OrgChartOptions): OrgChart; layoutOrgChart(roots: readonly OrgChartLayoutInput[], options: OrgChartLayoutOptions): OrgChartLayout. Export subpath @absoluteui/components/org-chart-export: orgChartToSvg(chart: OrgChart, options?: OrgChartExportOptions): string; orgChartToPng(chart, options?): Promise<Blob>; downloadOrgChart(chart, options: OrgChartDownloadOptions): Promise<void>

options.name: label
options.description: Accessible name of the tree (aria-label); the toolbar is named '{label} controls'. Non-empty.

options.name: nodes
options.description: Flat nodes: { id (unique), parentId (manager id or null for a top-level node), label (name), title?, description?, hasChildren? (reports exist but load through loadChildren), locked? (cannot be moved in edit mode) }. Validated: unique ids, known parents, no cycles (ORG_CHART_OPTIONS). Sibling order follows the array. Replacing it with update() clears the undo history.

options.name: expanded
options.description: Explicitly expanded node ids (overrides expandDepth). Read the current set from the expanded getter.

options.name: selected
options.description: Selected node id (aria-selected=true).

options.name: renderNode
options.description: Card content ({ depth, expanded, childCount, doc } context). Return non-interactive content: the treeitem is the control and its text is its accessible name. Default: initials, label, title, description.

options.name: loadChildren
options.description: Loads the reports of a node with hasChildren on its first expansion (validated; each parentId must be a known or returned node). Rejections and timeouts keep the node collapsed, announce the failure, and emit aui-load-error.

options.name: editable
options.description: Edit mode: re-parent nodes by pointer drag onto the new manager, Ctrl/Cmd+X then Ctrl/Cmd+V, or the toolbar Move / Move here buttons; undo and redo.

options.name: canMove
options.description: Veto a move (edit mode and moveNode). Cycles and locked nodes are always refused.

options.name: historyLimit
options.description: Undo depth, integer 0..500 (0 disables history).

options.name: nodeRadius
options.description: Card corner radius in CSS px, 0..50. Unset: --aui-chart-node-radius, else --aui-chart-corner-radius, else the theme's radius-md. Written as --aui-chart-node-radius through the CSSOM; the SVG export keeps it.

options.name: orientation
options.description: 'vertical': managers above their reports (top-down); 'horizontal': managers at the inline start, reports toward the inline end.

options.name: nodeWidth
options.description: Card width in CSS px, integer 80..600.

options.name: nodeHeight
options.description: Card height in CSS px, integer 32..400.

options.name: siblingGap
options.description: Space between neighboring cards of a level, integer 4..400 CSS px.

options.name: levelGap
options.description: Space between levels (connector length), integer 16..400 CSS px.

options.name: expandDepth
options.description: Levels expanded initially when `expanded` is not given (integer 0..64; 0 shows only the top-level nodes).

options.name: minZoom
options.description: Smallest zoom factor, 0.05..1.

options.name: maxZoom
options.description: Largest zoom factor, 1..8.

options.name: requestTimeoutMs
options.description: loadChildren timeout in ms (integer 100..600000); the signal is aborted with a TimeoutError.

options.name: locale
options.description: Locale of search, typeahead, report counts, zoom percentages, and messages.

options.name: direction
options.description: rtl mirrors the layout (first report on the right; horizontal charts grow to the left) and swaps ArrowLeft/ArrowRight.

properties.name: nodes
properties.description: Every node with its current manager, in tree order (copies, for saving after edits and lazy loads).

properties.name: geometry
properties.description: Visible layout (boxes, edges, size), nodes, a rendered card for computed colors, and the highlighted path (used by org-chart-export).

methods.name: update
methods.description: Merge and apply options (validated first). nodes replaces the data (undo history cleared, expansion kept for ids that still exist); expanded or expandDepth resets the expansion. No event.

methods.name: setExpanded
methods.description: Expand (loading lazy reports first) or collapse a node. Emits aui-expand-change.

methods.name: expandAll | collapseAll
methods.description: Expand every node with loaded reports (lazy nodes are not loaded) / collapse all.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Ids whose label, title, or description contains the text (case-insensitive, locale-aware), in tree order, including collapsed nodes.

methods.name: pathTo
methods.description: Ids from the top-level node down to the node.

methods.name: reveal
methods.signature: reveal(id: string, options?: { focus?: boolean; select?: boolean; highlight?: boolean }): void
methods.description: Expand the node's managers, center it, highlight its path (cards and connectors; default on), focus it (default) and optionally select it; announces 'Path: A, B, C.'

methods.name: select
methods.description: Select a node without emitting aui-node-select.

methods.name: centerOn
methods.description: Center the view on a visible node (keeps the zoom).

methods.name: fit
methods.description: Scale (at most 100 %) and center the whole visible chart in the viewport; announces the zoom.

methods.name: zoomTo
methods.description: Zoom around the viewport center, clamped to minZoom..maxZoom; announces 'Zoom {percent}' and emits aui-zoom.

methods.name: moveNode
methods.signature: moveNode(id: string, parentId: string | null, index?: number): boolean
methods.description: Re-parent a node (index among the new siblings, default last; null parent = top level). Returns false (and announces) when refused: cycle, locked node, or canMove. Undoable; emits aui-node-move.

methods.name: undo | redo
methods.description: Undo / redo the last move (parent and position). Announce and emit aui-node-move (reason 'undo' / 'redo'); false when there is nothing to undo/redo.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Abort loads; remove the toolbar, viewport, listeners, and host classes.

events.name: aui-node-select
events.description: A node was selected by click, Enter, or Space.

events.name: aui-expand-change
events.description: A node was expanded (after its reports loaded) or collapsed through the UI or setExpanded.

events.name: aui-node-move
events.detail: OrgChartNodeMoveDetail { reason: 'move' | 'undo' | 'redo'; id: string; parentId: string | null; previousParentId: string | null; index: number; nodes: OrgChartNode[] }
events.description: A node got a new manager (drag, paste, toolbar, moveNode, undo, redo). Save detail.nodes or send the change to the server.

events.name: aui-zoom
events.description: The zoom changed through the toolbar, keys, Ctrl/Cmd + wheel, or zoomTo (fit does not emit).

events.name: aui-load-error
events.description: loadChildren rejected, timed out, or returned invalid nodes.

contentAreas.name: renderNode
contentAreas.description: Card content of each node (default: initials, label, title, description). Inserted once per node and re-rendered when the node's label, title, or description changes, or renderNode changes.

cssClasses.name: aui-org-chart
cssClasses.description: Host; aui-org-chart--editing in edit mode, aui-org-chart--horizontal for the horizontal orientation.

cssClasses.name: aui-org-chart__toolbar | __tool
cssClasses.description: Toolbar group and its buttons (aria-disabled at limits; the Move button is a toggle, aria-pressed).

cssClasses.name: aui-org-chart__viewport | --panning
cssClasses.description: Clipping viewport (block-size 30rem by default: set block-size to size the chart); background drags pan.

cssClasses.name: aui-org-chart__canvas
cssClasses.description: Transformed canvas (translate and scale through the CSSOM); --aui-org-chart-node-width and --aui-org-chart-node-height.

cssClasses.name: aui-org-chart__links | __link | __link--path
cssClasses.description: Connector SVG (aria-hidden) and paths; highlighted path.

cssClasses.name: aui-org-chart__node | --path | --cut | --locked | --dragging | --drop | --no-drop
cssClasses.description: Treeitems positioned through the CSSOM (left, top); states for the highlighted path, the node being moved, locked, dragged, and valid/invalid drop targets.

cssClasses.name: aui-org-chart__card
cssClasses.description: Card box inside each node (selected: color-selected with a strong border).

cssClasses.name: aui-org-chart__avatar | __text | __name | __title | __description | __sep
cssClasses.description: Default card content; __sep holds visually hidden separators for the accessible name.

cssClasses.name: aui-org-chart__toggle
cssClasses.description: Expand chip with the report count (pointer target, aria-hidden; the treeitem handles keys).

iconSlots.name: toolbar
iconSlots.default: zoom-out, zoom-in, maximize (fit), grip (move), check (move here), undo, redo

iconSlots.name: expand chip
iconSlots.default: chevron-down / chevron-up (vertical); chevron-right / chevron-left (horizontal, mirrored in RTL)
